label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.2 a.3…: Whatever regularly attains what is best for it…
locator: I q.2 a.3 co., quinta via: non a casu, sed ex intentione perveniunt ad finem
interpretation: The inference unde patet ... non a casu, sed ex intentione needs an exhaustive dichotomy for what regularly attains the best: chance or intention. Intentio is read broadly as a thing's tending to its end; that the tending needs a knower is the next premise. Restricted to the best, so bare material necessity, indifferent to the best, is not a third option inside the reading. A selection account rejects this dichotomy.
